sites.why: Rule 4: streaming chat.completions.create on AsyncOpenAI built from LLMConfig (base_url/api_key from config, default None = api.openai.com). In BaseLLMClient.__call__ (core/llm/base.py:217-233) the client is rebuilt with default_headers Authorization: Bearer <state_manager.get_access_token()>, the user's Pythagora access token from the UI/IPC response or --access-token, so the credential is per user/session. Model is runtime self.config.model (OpenAI-family literals include gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, a dated equivalent, so rule 6 alone would not fire). The same expression also serves AzureClient (subclass, AsyncAzureOpenAI with azure_endpoint, which on its own would be kept by rule 2).

Rule 4: messages.stream on AsyncAnthropic built from LLMConfig (base_url from config, default None = api.anthropic.com; may also be a bedrock/anthropic proxy). base.py:234-244 rebuilds the client with Authorization: Bearer <per-user access token from state_manager>. Also rule 6: model is runtime and none of the repo's Claude literals (claude-sonnet-4-20250514, claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022/20240620, claude-3-haiku-20240307, claude-3-opus-20240229) is a catalog id or dated equivalence.
Rule 2: AsyncGroq SDK chat.completions.create goes to Groq's endpoint (another vendor).
Rule 2: httpx POST to https://api.pythagora.io/v1/relace/merge (Relace code-merge model behind Pythagora's API), not an OpenAI/Anthropic endpoint; model relace-code-merge comes from agent config.
